name: Barycentric Mapping for Tensor Shape Exploration
definition: An affine mapping from dimension $D$ to $D-1$ projecting points onto a hyper-plane, used to control a 2D opacity transfer function and color lookup based on tensor anisotropy indices.
summary: Barycentric Mapping projects tensor anisotropy onto a 2D triangular domain to visually separate isotropic, linear, and planar diffusion regimes, emphasizing structural features while rendering isotropic regions transparent.
